senses.gloss: (חוּס 2) connection, relationship, legally recognized ancestry or descent.
units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 69a:5">Kidd. 69ᵃ</cite> <he>עבד אין לו ח׳</he> a slave has no legal relations (paternity); <cite ref="Yevamot 23a:8">Yeb. 23ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 88a:20">B. Kam. 88ᵃ</cite> <he>שאין להם ח׳ בנים</he> who have no legitimate sons (i.e. slaves); <he>שאין להם ח׳ אבות</he> who have no legitimate parentage.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 88a:20">Ib.</cite> <he>גר נהי דאין לו ח׳ למעלה וכ׳</he> the proselyte, though he has no relationship upwards (with his relations before his conversion), has relations downwards (with his children born in Judaism); a. e.
